description: This file contains utility functions and main script logic for detecting and warning about usage of os.tmpdir()/tmpdir() in specific source files within a project. It imports TypeScript utilities and other project-specific modules to analyze source code for specific import statements and function calls related to temporary directory handling.

methods.name: collectOsTmpdirImports
methods.description: Analyzes a TypeScript source file to identify imports related to 'os' or 'node:os' modules, specifically tracking imported names and the 'tmpdir' identifier.

methods.name: findMessagingTmpdirCallLines
methods.description: Parses content to identify lines where 'os.tmpdir()' or 'tmpdir()' are called in code, based on the import analysis.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that sets up and runs source code analysis to detect 'tmpdir()' usage.
